The interface
ara::crypto::cryp::
KeyAgreementPrivateCtx::SetKey
shall ensure the provided
ara::crypto::
cryp::PrivateKey
is used in the following key agreement. The interface shall re-
turn
•
kUsageViolation

kAllowKeyAgreement
of the
provided
ara::crypto::cryp::PrivateKey
is not set.
•
kIncompatibleObject

ara::crypto::cryp::Pri-
vateKey

ara::crypto::cryp::CryptoProvider
instance.
•
kIncompatibleObject
, if the
ara::crypto::CryptoAlgId
of the pro-
vided
ara::crypto::cryp::PrivateKey
is not compatible with the
ara::
crypto::CryptoAlgId
used to instantiate this context.
